# `layout.enclosure.edit`

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs-gen` from crates/ew-commands/schemas/layout.enclosure.edit.schema.json. Do not edit: change the source and regenerate. -->

`layout.enclosure.edit` (`EditEnclosure`, FT-840): moves an enclosure in its layout space. The pose is a translation
with the identity rotation at this version (ruling 7: bayed suites are 1.x). Nothing else changes. Rejected: an
enclosure that does not exist (`/enclosure`); a turned pose. Interactive. Outcome: the enclosure.

## Types

### CmdPose3

A pose: the translation t = [x, y, z] in nanometres and the rotation q = [w, x, y, z], a sign-normalised unit quaternion in 10^-9 (doc 05 §3.2).

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `q` | array of (integer (min -2000000000, max 2000000000), integer (min -2000000000, max 2000000000), integer (min -2000000000, max 2000000000), integer (min -2000000000, max 2000000000)) (at least 4 item(s), at most 4 item(s)) | yes |  |  |
| `t` | array of (integer (min -9007199254740991, max 9007199254740991), integer (min -9007199254740991, max 9007199254740991), integer (min -9007199254740991, max 9007199254740991)) (at least 3 item(s), at most 3 item(s)) | yes |  |  |

### CmdUuid

A lower-case hyphenated UUID naming a record (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: string (at least 36 character(s), at most 36 character(s))

Pattern: `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$`

## Exit codes

A command runs as one line of a command log replayed by `ew apply` ([doc 17 §3.5](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#35-command-logs-ewcmd)). The exit code of `ew apply` is:

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | The line committed as one transaction. |
| 1 | A prevent rule or the command's own domain rule refused the line (`Prevented`, `Rejected`); without `--one-step` the lines before it stay committed and are saved, with `--one-step` nothing is saved. |
| 2 | Anything else stops the replay: invalid parameters, a missing record, an unresolvable reference, an open, lock or save error. |

The codes of every subcommand are in [doc 17 §3.2](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#32-exit-codes).
